title: Expression evaluation
statement: Given a state, evaluate an arithmetic expression as an integer: a constant has its natural-number value, a variable has the value assigned to its index, and an operation applies addition, subtraction, or multiplication to the values of its two subexpressions. A load evaluates its address expression, converts that integer to a natural number, and returns the memory value at that address.
